title: Decode XORed Array
description: There is a hidden integer array `arr` consisting of `n` non-negative integers. It was encoded into another integer array `encoded` of length `n - 1` such that `encoded[i] = arr[i] XOR arr[i + 1]` for every `0 <= i < n - 1`. Given `encoded` and the first element `first = arr[0]`, return the original array `arr`.
hints: XOR is its own inverse: if `encoded[i] = arr[i] ^ arr[i + 1]`, then `arr[i + 1] = arr[i] ^ encoded[i]`.
Initialize the result array with `first` and iteratively XOR the last decoded element with `encoded[i]`.

examples.explanation: With a single encoded value 0, both elements equal first = 5.
